name: Engle-Granger cointegration pair trading (z-score)
author: je-suis-tm
indicators: OLS hedge ratio via Engle-Granger two-step; residual z-score
entry_long: residual z-score beyond +/- threshold: long underpriced leg, short overpriced
exit: exit at mean reversion; abandon if cointegration breaks (retest)
implementation_notes: Thresholds in code; needs shorting both legs; free data (Yahoo) but equities. Crypto version: pick pairs w/ rolling ADF. Repo note: educational scripts (Yahoo/histdata), not production.
